articles.headline: Nikola Jokic records 200th career triple-double in Nuggets' win over Pelicans
articles.description: Denver's Nikola Jokic had 21 points, 13 rebounds and 10 assists for his 200th career triple-double Wednesday night as the Nuggets beat the Pelicans. He needs 10 more to supplant the retired Russell Westbrook as the NBA leader.

articles.headline: Curry scores 44 points as the Warriors hold on to beat the Timberwolves 119-114
articles.description: — Stephen Curry scored a season-high 44 points, rookie Yaxel Lendeborg had 26 and Golden State Warriors held on Wednesday night for a 119-114 victory over the Minnesota Timberwolves, who were without injured guard Anthony Edwards.
